external_entities.name: colleague
external_entities.description: A colleague who signs in through the identity broker and uses applications.
external_entities.source_excerpt: Everything colleagues use signs them in through one identity broker.

external_entities.name: franchise colleague
external_entities.description: A colleague from a franchise store who is vouched for by the franchise store's identity provider.
external_entities.source_excerpt: Franchise colleagues do not have staff accounts with us; their own identity provider vouches for them and the broker takes that as a sign-in.

external_entities.name: identity provider
external_entities.description: An identity provider operated by the franchise organization that vouches for franchise colleagues.
external_entities.source_excerpt: their own identity provider vouches for them

external_entities.name: HR system
external_entities.description: The HR system that supplies group-membership changes to the identity broker overnight.
external_entities.source_excerpt: it comes from the HR system overnight

processes.name: identity broker
processes.description: The broker signs colleagues in, issues tokens, signs tokens, supplies public keys, consumes HR changes, and writes audit events.
processes.source_excerpt: Everything colleagues use signs them in through one identity broker.

processes.name: application
processes.description: An application that accepts a broker-issued token and decides what a colleague may do from the groups in it.
processes.source_excerpt: Every application takes that token and decides what the colleague may do from the groups in it.

processes.name: store admin console
processes.description: An application on the corporate network that lets a holder with the store-manager group change prices and void transactions across every store.
processes.source_excerpt: The store admin console is one of those applications. It also runs on the corporate network.

data_stores.name: key store
data_stores.description: A key store holding the signing key used by the identity broker for tokens.
data_stores.source_excerpt: The broker signs tokens with a signing key it keeps in a key store.

data_stores.name: directory
data_stores.description: The identity broker's directory containing colleagues and their group memberships.
data_stores.source_excerpt: The broker keeps the colleagues and the groups they are in its own directory.

data_stores.name: audit log
data_stores.description: The audit log to which the broker writes sign-ins.
data_stores.source_excerpt: The broker writes sign-ins to an audit log.
data_stores.notes: The source does not state what the log records or whether it covers the franchise route.

data_flows.name: sign-in
data_flows.description: A colleague signs in through the identity broker.
data_flows.source_excerpt: Colleagues sign in to it from wherever they are, including their own devices at home.

data_flows.name: issue token
data_flows.description: The identity broker issues a token to a colleague containing the colleague's staff ID and groups.
data_flows.source_excerpt: Once the broker has signed a colleague in it issues them a token.
data_flows.data_description: token containing staff id and group membership

data_flows.name: present token
data_flows.description: A colleague presents the broker-issued token to an application.
data_flows.source_excerpt: Every application takes that token
data_flows.data_description: token containing staff id and group membership

data_flows.name: change prices and void transactions
data_flows.description: A colleague uses a store-manager token at the store admin console to change prices and void transactions.
data_flows.source_excerpt: If the token has the store-manager group in it, the console lets the holder change prices and void transactions.
data_flows.data_description: store-manager token, price changes, and void transactions

data_flows.name: read signing key
data_flows.description: The identity broker uses the signing key held in the key store to sign tokens.
data_flows.source_excerpt: The broker signs tokens with a signing key it keeps in a key store.

data_flows.name: fetch public key
data_flows.description: An application fetches the public half of the signing key from the identity broker to check token signatures.
data_flows.source_excerpt: Applications fetch the public half from the broker to check the signature.
data_flows.data_description: public half of token signing key

data_flows.name: pull group changes
data_flows.description: The identity broker pulls colleague and group-membership changes from the HR system overnight.
data_flows.source_excerpt: The broker pulls the changes once a night

data_flows.name: update directory
data_flows.description: The identity broker updates its directory with colleague and group-membership information.
data_flows.source_excerpt: The broker keeps the colleagues and the groups they are in its own directory.

data_flows.name: vouch for colleague
data_flows.description: A franchise colleague uses the franchise identity provider for sign-in.
data_flows.source_excerpt: Franchise colleagues do not have staff accounts with us; their own identity provider vouches for them

data_flows.name: federated sign-in
data_flows.description: The franchise identity provider vouches for a franchise colleague and the identity broker accepts that as a sign-in.
data_flows.source_excerpt: their own identity provider vouches for them and the broker takes that as a sign-in
data_flows.notes: The source does not state which colleagues the identity provider is allowed to vouch for.

data_flows.name: write sign-in
data_flows.description: The identity broker writes sign-in events to the audit log.
data_flows.source_excerpt: The broker writes sign-ins to an audit log.
data_flows.notes: The source does not state whether the log covers the franchise route.

trust_boundaries.name: corporate network
trust_boundaries.description: The corporate network where the identity broker and store admin console run.
trust_boundaries.source_excerpt: The broker runs on the corporate network.

trust_boundaries.name: home devices
trust_boundaries.description: The zone containing colleagues' own devices at home.
trust_boundaries.source_excerpt: including their own devices at home

trust_boundaries.name: franchise stores
trust_boundaries.description: The separately controlled franchise-store environment whose colleagues use their own identity provider.
trust_boundaries.source_excerpt: We also let the franchise stores in.
